Papers will be edited by Stefan Green, Judith König, Antti Laato and Tobias Nicklas and published in the series WUNT (Mohr Siebeck).

In this research project Topias Tanskanen has defended his doctoral dissertation (Jacob, the Torah, and the Abrahamic Promise: Studies on the Use and Interpretation of the Jacob Story in the Book of Jubilees) on May 30, 2023. The Faculty Opponent was Professor Loren Stuckenbruck from the University of Munich. The dissertation has been accepted in the series Deuterocanonical and Cognate Literature Studies (Berlin: de Gruyter).
